stories.title: Anthropic launches Claude Ship, letting AI agents review, fix, and approve code changes
stories.simple_summary: Anthropic made a new tool called Claude Ship that lets AI automatically review and approve code changes made by programmers. This saves developers time on routine checking tasks.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to software engineers and tech companies. Unless you write computer code for work, there's nothing you need to do.

stories.title: Supertake raises $20M to let AI agents turn your market predictions into stock portfolios
stories.simple_summary: A company called Supertake raised money to sell a service where AI picks stocks for you based on your market predictions. You tell the AI where you think the market is going, and it builds a portfolio without you choosing individual stocks.
stories.why_it_matters: This is for people interested in stock investing. It's very risky, and most ordinary people should stick with traditional investment advice from a human financial advisor.

stories.title: Elon Musk and others rejoice as Jensen Huang is reinstated at Nvidia amid scandal
stories.simple_summary: Jensen Huang, who runs the computer chip company Nvidia, is back in his job after stepping away briefly. Various important people including Elon Musk said this was the right decision.
stories.why_it_matters: This matters mostly to investors in Nvidia stock. For regular people, Nvidia chips power many AI systems, but this leadership change doesn't affect you directly.

stories.title: Megaspeed, the company at the center of the Jensen Huang scandal, appears headed for a US blacklist
stories.simple_summary: Megaspeed is a company that was involved in a scandal. The U.S. government appears ready to ban American companies from doing business with it without special permission.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors and companies doing international business. Unless you deal with trade regulations, this doesn't affect your daily life.

stories.title: Nvidia employees greet Jensen Huang like a hero as he returns to company’s HQ
stories.simple_summary: Jensen Huang returned to work at Nvidia and employees welcomed him enthusiastically. He promised to be a better leader this time around.
stories.why_it_matters: This is company news about Nvidia's leadership. It doesn't affect ordinary people or small-business owners.

stories.title: Claude AI can review pull requests and ship fixes on its own now
stories.simple_summary: Claude is an AI tool that can now automatically review code written by programmers, suggest fixes, and approve the changes. Previously it could only review code.
stories.why_it_matters: This matters to software engineers writing code for a living. Regular people won't use this directly.

stories.title: How Jensen Huang ended up as Nvidia CEO again
stories.simple_summary: Jensen Huang founded Nvidia thirty years ago and recently stepped down as CEO due to personal issues involving his marriage. He has now returned to the job.
stories.why_it_matters: This is news about Nvidia's leadership. Unless you own Nvidia stock, this doesn't affect you.

stories.title: Google Search’s AI Mode can now tap into Drive and Wallet for more personalized responses
stories.simple_summary: Google's AI search tool can now look at your Google Drive files and Google Wallet information to give you more personalized answers. It uses data already stored in your Google account.
stories.why_it_matters: If you use Google Search and have a Google account, your searches might become more personalized. Be aware that Google will use your files and wallet information to do this.

stories.title: Nothing’s upcoming Ear Note is a pair of earbuds with AI transcription
stories.simple_summary: A company called Nothing is making earbuds that can record conversations and turn them into written text automatically. The earbuds also create AI-made summaries of what was said.
stories.why_it_matters: If you attend lots of meetings or interviews, these earbuds could save you time transcribing notes. This is a convenience tool, not essential for most people.

stories.title: Oregon and Virginia sue SpaceX over Grok’s porn deepfakes
stories.simple_summary: Two U.S. states are suing SpaceX because Grok, an AI tool on X social media, was used to create fake adult images of real people without their permission. The states say SpaceX didn't use standard safety protections.
stories.why_it_matters: If you or your family members use X social media, you should know this tool can be misused to create fake inappropriate images of real people. Be cautious about your personal information online.

stories.title: Jensen Huang scheduled to testify next week in Senate following reinstatement as Nvidia CEO
stories.simple_summary: Jensen Huang will testify before the U.S. Senate next week about his personal affair and suspected involvement with someone connected to China. This follows his reinstatement as Nvidia CEO.
stories.why_it_matters: This is about government oversight of tech company leadership. Unless you follow tech industry news closely, this doesn't directly affect you.

stories.title: Opinion | Artificial Intelligence Can’t Replace a Doctor
stories.simple_summary: An opinion piece in the Wall Street Journal argues that AI cannot replace doctors and human medical care. The article likely explains why human judgment matters in healthcare.
stories.why_it_matters: This is a reminder that AI tools in medicine should support doctors, not replace them. If you use healthcare services, human doctors will still be making important medical decisions.
